Consulting & Sales: Introduce and sell high-end fashion products for men and women, including couture áo dài, silk accessories, and made-to-order services tailored to customer needs (Suits, Dresses, Áo Dài, etc.).
Customer Care: Build long-term relationships, maintain a professional image, and deliver a “5-star” customer experience.
Styling & Personalization: Provide style consultations, outfit coordination, and share knowledge about silk materials and the cultural heritage of Vietnamese áo dài.
Product Management & Visual Merchandising: Ensure the showroom is always elegant, refined, and aligned with luxury visual standards.
Sales Tracking & Reporting: Achieve sales targets and prepare periodic performance reports for management.
Events & Showcases Participation: Support fashion shows, workshops, and cultural–fashion events organized by Byfas.
